description: PLATEAU evacuation simulation tools is published by MLIT Project PLATEAU. The PLATEAU repository supplies walking and vehicle flood-evacuation simulation components and web-viewer documentation. Its stated coverage is The Kumamoto PLATEAU use case and configurable three-dimensional city models. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. Source code and setup information are linked through the public repository; nothing was installed or executed. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is MIT. One public project release; the existing case record does not explicitly cover this later accessible software package. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record case_study-kumamoto-plateau-flood-evacuation-simulation provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
